name: kitsuvo
description: Browse with Kitsuvo, inspect evidence of AI-built sites, and check responsive layouts in your desktop browser.

interface.longDescription: Use your Kitsuvo desktop browser to navigate sites, read page text, interact with accessible elements, and inspect the evidence behind AI-built, slop, and impersonation verdicts. Check phone and tablet layouts. Automation uses a separate browser profile by default. Requires Kitsuvo installed on this computer; cloud clients need the local MCP bridge and Secure MCP Tunnel.
defaultPrompt: Open this site in Kitsuvo and explain its detection evidence.
Check this page at phone and desktop sizes.
